header:
Awesome AI Assistants

> Open-source AI assistants, chat apps, voice assistants, agent frameworks, memory and local model tools. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Know where your data goes.** Local models keep data on your machine, hosted APIs do not.
- **Limit tool access.** Give an agent only the folders, accounts and keys it needs.
- **Check the license.** Model weights often have their own terms.
- **Expect change.** This field moves fast, so look at the last commit.
